Jeremy D. Popkin

About the author

Jeremy D. Popkin, William T. Bryan chair professor of history at the University of Kentucky, has written numerous books on the history of the French and Haitian Revolutions, including _The First Emancipation: The Forgotten History of Abolition in Revolutionary France_ (2026), _A New World Begins: The History of the French Revolution_ (2019), and _You Are All Free: The Haitian Revolution and the Abolition of Slavery_ (2010). He has also written several books about historiography: _From Herodotus to H-Net_ (2nd ed., 2021) and _History, Historians and Autobiography_ (2005), as well as a biography of his grandmother, _Zelda Popkin: The Life and Times of an American Jewish Woman Writer_ (2023). He lives in Lexington, Kentucky.
